scope: Read-only Tina BXM kernel-side audit against current Linux 6.18.63-t736-hdmi-v14; no compile, board access, package installation or driver/source mutation.

donor.license: README offers MIT or GPLv2; retain per-file license notices
donor.generated_config_notes: Targets 6.6.98-t736-distro with gcc-arm-10.3-2021.07; includes Linux DVFS, native DMA fences and buffer sync. Regenerate for candidate kernel instead of reusing absolute old build paths.

compatibility_6_18.finding: drm_driver.date initializer remains but date field is absent in 6.18 drm_driver.
platform_driver.remove expects void callback in 6.18; donor pvr_remove returns int.
MODULE_IMPORT_NS requires namespace string in current kernel; donor uses unquoted DMA_BUF.
from_timer and del_timer_sync are absent in 6.18 headers; current APIs are timer_container_of and timer_delete_sync.
If CONFIG_DEVFREQ_THERMAL is enabled, direct tz->ops->get_temp dereference is invalid against opaque thermal_zone_device; use supported thermal API.

compatibility_6_18.kind: existing forward compatibility, not a new blocker
compatibility_6_18.finding: Driver already contains >=6.7 shrinker_alloc/register/free path, >=6.3 vm_flags helpers and class_create compatibility; avoid treating old preprocessor branches as active 6.18 failures.

compatibility_6_18.kind: porting audit requirement, not claimed unique to 6.18
compatibility_6_18.finding: Recheck DMA-BUF reservation-lock, vmap/map_attachment, GEM lifetime and fence contracts. Some vendor paths call dma_buf_vmap directly; current locked helper asserts reservation lock.

Vendor module imports OPP/devfreq/thermal and sunxi_get_soc_dvfs symbols absent from current v14 exported-symbol set. Old module imports also differ because of inlining/config/API changes; this is not a patch list for binary symbol renaming. Rebuild from source with intended config.

interrupts.name: IRQGPUDVFS
interrupts.condition: SUNXI_DVFS_CTRL_ENABLE controls whether second IRQ is requested

clock_reset_dependencies.porting_note: Do not write generic gates without carrying the SoC key/register conventions; verify shared parent clocks used by existing display/peripherals.

pck_provider.required_clock: pck / r-ppu, R_CCU 0x07010000 + 0x1ac bit0, parent dcxo, CLK_R_PPU=19

power_dependencies.tina_core_handling: Tina DT enables GPU_TOP domain but comments GPU_CORE node. sunxi_platform hard-defines USE_FPGA=1, writes CORE+0x20=0, CORE control=8 on / 0 off, and separately uses runtime PM for TOP. Do not silently omit this core power dependency.
known_glue_error_handling: PCK timeout logs but returns success in donor path.
Direct CORE ioremap/write path has no failure or status checks.
Clock bus lookup checks clk_core instead of clk_bus at sunxi_platform.c:121.
regulator_get_optional checks NULL instead of IS_ERR at sunxi_platform.c:835; absent supply can become an error-pointer dereference.

external_core_always_on_evidence.provenance: Reported by parent agent; not independently inspected in this subtask
external_core_always_on_evidence.finding: A733 GPU_CORE uses GENPD_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON; external DT uses GPU_CORE and GPU_TOP. Supports keeping CORE powered during first integration instead of assuming runtime CORE power cycling is validated.
external_core_always_on_evidence.boundary: External A7Z reports are not T736 board validation; its upstream powervr/Mesa route has a different userspace ABI.

regulator_opp_sid.supply: AXP8191 on s_twi0 at address 0x36; gpu-supply=reg_dcdc5
regulator_opp_sid.opp_note: Board silicon/VF table can select different voltages; 300 MHz entry is commented. Values above describe donor defaults, not a newly validated operating point.
regulator_opp_sid.dvfs_behavior: Reads SID sunxi_get_soc_dvfs and vf_mapping_table, chooses opp-microvolt-vfXXXX/vfdefault, then overwrites initial clk_rate and voltage with maximum OPP.
porting_requirements: Real PMIC bus/regulator provider is required by current platform code; PC/PH firmware fixed rails do not represent GPU DCDC5.
Do not rely on clk_rate alone for a fixed conservative start. Correct or deliberately replace DVFS initialization while retaining matched DDK bridge options.
Validate zero/single/too-many OPP cases before use: current sorting accesses indices 0 and 1, no-entry max selection can underflow, maximum-count check occurs after table write.
If using fixed initial frequency, make frequency/voltage and power policy explicit in candidate platform code; keep dynamic DVFS/thermal enablement as a separately verified step.

iommu_assessment.required_for_current_tina_gpu_minimum_pa: Not established; current donor path has no external GPU IOMMU attachment.
facts: GPU node has no iommus property.
CPU physical to device physical mapping is identity; general and firmware physical heaps are UMA.
ARM64 platform DMA mask is 48-bit; internal Rogue GPU MMU is managed by DDK.
SMMU reset-name strings exist, but clock/reset acquisition requests only reset_bus.
Presence of separate Allwinner IOMMU node does not prove this GPU is attached to it.
iommu_assessment.boundary: This does not prove arbitrary GPU BOs are directly usable by the non-IOMMU display controller; PRIME scanout constraints are separate.

gpu_to_display_interop.status: Required early hardware gate; not validated
confirmed_limits: Import rejects when drm_prime_get_contiguous_size(sgt) is smaller than the dma-buf size (-EINVAL). This means a contiguous DMA address span, not merely a fixed number of SG entries.
VMAP import also requires exporter dma_buf_vmap support before contiguous-address check.
DE programming uses one base DMA address per plane plus offsets/pitch; v14 display has no IOMMU.
Rogue GPU-side virtual-contiguous allocation does not by itself guarantee display-side DMA contiguity.
earliest_tests: Export real GPU-rendered LINEAR XR24/AR24 dma-buf, import on existing sunxi display, create framebuffer, verify acquire/retire fence ordering and physical presentation.

If GPU allocations are scattered, test DE/CMA-created linear scanout buffer exported to GPU for EGL/dma-buf import and rendering, then presented by DE. Availability of that path depends on selected UM extension/winsys support and remains unknown.
Exercise repeated buffer reuse/page flips and mode changes before enabling GNOME acceleration.
gpu_to_display_interop.success_boundary: renderD128 appearance, firmware boot and offscreen GPU render are necessary but do not prove desktop presentation.

node_order_risk.finding: Vendor PVR registers a DRM primary and render device (DRIVER_MODESET|DRIVER_RENDER|DRIVER_GEM); loading it can change card numbering. Existing Xorg kmsdev=/dev/dri/card0 must still select sunxi DE, not the GPU primary. Bind/identify DRM nodes by device/driver instead of assuming order.

firmware.page_note: v14 is 4K. Loader adds .64k only for MIPS+64K CPU pages; no .16k selection branch was found.

do_not_mix.note: Same BVNC names plus .16k image, different build.

firmware.abi_rule: Match DDK major/minor and compatible build-option mask with selected UM and firmware. UM revision mismatch warns by default and is fatal under PVRSRV_STRICT_COMPAT_CHECK; do not interpret non-strict warning as validation of mixed binaries.

missing_providers: PCK GPU_TOP/GPU_CORE policy and r-ppu clock
GPU OPP/SID VF support if retaining vendor DVFS

native_powervr_status.finding: Current v14 source supported-device comment lists AXE-1-16M and BXS-4-64 MC1, not this BXM. Enabling its config alone is not established support.

recommended_tina_to_v14_sequence: Keep existing fixed LPDDR4x SPL/vendor DDR, source TF-A/U-Boot and validated v14 recovery intact. Create an isolated candidate kernel/DT/module/rootfs bundle rather than overwrite donor Tina sources.
Select one matched BXM DDK 24.2 UM+firmware bundle; record hashes and bridge options. Keep existing sunxi DE KMS as display controller; no vendor dc_sunxi replacement is required by this build.

Add real GPU clocks/reset/interconnect gates, r-ppu/PCK TOP and CORE policy, and real DCDC5 regulator support. Preserve shared-clock behavior. Correct platform error handling and make initial fixed frequency/voltage explicit before enabling automatic DVFS; account for external GPU_CORE ALWAYS_ON evidence.

Adapt the confirmed 6.18 API mismatches and regenerate module config against the candidate kernel. Full compile/modpost and runtime power/fence validation are still required; no build was attempted in this audit.

First validate module bind, power/clock state, BVNC and matching firmware response, then an actual GPU job. Immediately test DMA-BUF/PRIME allocation, GPU rendering, fence synchronization and DE scanout in both feasible allocation directions.

Only after presentation passes should the desktop select GPU EGL/GL and remove forced software-rendering overrides. Preserve a software-rendering recovery configuration and avoid hard-coded DRM card enumeration.
Treat the parent-reported external upstream PowerVR+Mesa branch as a separate candidate stack. Do not feed Tina UM libraries to upstream PowerVR DRM ABI.
not_claimed: No module compiled or loaded for v14.
No GPU job, power sequence, PRIME import or desktop acceleration tested on this board in this audit.
No claim that an existing 6.6 .ko can be reused on 6.18.
No claim that external IOMMU/SMMU port is mandatory for the donor GPU path.
No change to source boot chain or LPDDR4x parameters.
